findings.message: Composition uses GSAP but no GSAP script is loaded. The animation will not run.
<div id="scene-hook"> is a timeline element that contains nested <div>. The timeline shows one row per top-level element, and the root composition is built only from sub-compositions.
findings.fixHint: Move <div id="scene-hook"> and its contents into a sub-composition file and mount it with data-composition-src.

findings.message: data-motion-blur="on" is set but nothing in the composition moves fast enough to blur, so it has no effect
findings.fixHint: animate an element's transform or position by 2+ px per frame; if the motion is set from a timeline callback (onUpdate, render(t)), add data-motion-blur-events="on"; otherwise drop data-motion-blur

findings.message: Only the audio advanced under seek; nothing on screen moved.
findings.fixHint: If the composition is meant to be still, add `data-no-timeline` to the element with `data-composition-id`. Otherwise confirm it seeks a paused GSAP/CSS timeline under `data-*` timing attributes rather than only autoplaying.

findings.message: Frame 0 shows only the background, and the first frame is the thumbnail on social players: have the title or key image already on screen at 0 s instead of entering from nothing; see references/review.md.
